description: Road Access Deprivation Modelled Dataset in Beira, Mozambique is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. This dataset represents the difference between planned and unplanned areas of the city as an indication of urban deprivation. Coverage: Mozambique. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are IDEAMAPS, Urban Deprivation, Road Accesibility, Beira, Mozambique. The repository dates the deposit 2025; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
